description:
Retrieves a STRING enrichment figure (image URL) for a set of proteins. For the enriched terms and FDR values, use `string_enrichment`.

- Each figure shows a single enrichment category; call again with another `category` to show a different one.
- Use the same proteins and species as the network and enrichment results already shown to the user, so the figure matches them.

category.description: Term category for enrichment. If omitted, STRING uses Process. Use Process/Function/Component for GO, KEGG for KEGG pathways, RCTM for Reactome, and PMID for publications.

color_palette.description: Color palette for FDR. If omitted, STRING uses mint_blue.

graph_type.description: Plot type: dotplot or barplot (horizontal bar chart). If omitted, STRING uses dotplot.

group_by_similarity.description: Visually groups terms based on term similarity. Default: 0.8. Details: string_help topic 'enrichment_grouping'.

number_of_terms_shown.description: Max number of terms shown on plot. Default: 10.

species.description: NCBI/STRING taxon (e.g. 9606 for human, or STRG0AXXXXX).

x_axis.description: Value shown on the X-axis; also selects and orders the terms. If omitted, STRING uses signal.

name: string_enrichment_image_url
title: STRING: Get enrichment result figure (image URL)
